public.title: Valid Anagram
public.description: Given strings first and second containing only lowercase English letters, return true if rearranging all letters of first can produce second. Each string has 0 to 1000 characters. Repeated letters count separately; two empty strings are anagrams. Aim for linear time.
hints: Compare how many times each letter occurs.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Lengths must match. Count letters in the first string, then consume one count per letter in the second. A missing count proves a mismatch. Time is O(n + m); the map holds at most 26 keys.
